question: On May 27, 2025, the Rajasthan High Court issued a directive regarding FIRs and financial transactions. What was one of the key mandates?

options.text: All FIRs must be approved by a magistrate before registration.
All property transactions must be conducted through digital payments
FIRs can only be filed for criminal offenses, not civil disputes.
Courts must report cash transactions over ₹2 lakh to the Income Tax Department.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Courts must report cash transactions over ₹2 lakh to the Income Tax Department.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Rajasthan High Court**, on **May 27, 2025**, issued a directive concerning cash transactions and their reporting to the **Income Tax Department**.
 
• As per the directive, courts are required to **report cash transactions exceeding ₹2 lakh** under specific circumstances to ensure compliance with **taxation laws**.
 
• This mandate aligns with existing regulations under the **Income Tax Act, 1961**, which prohibit cash transactions above ₹2 lakh for certain transactions to curb **black money** and promote transparency.
 
• The court's decision emphasizes the role of judicial and administrative bodies in ensuring compliance with **financial regulations** and preventing tax evasion.
 
• Such directives are aimed at improving accountability and strengthening the overall financial regulatory framewo
